notes: Experiment 7C complementary-coverage gate. Each client observes three one-second maneuvers at one client-specific constant speed; the ten clients in each oracle family jointly cover 10--30 m/s. LocalExtra receives the same number of transitions as the family pool, generated from the recipient vehicle over all ten speeds, and is an information-budget oracle rather than a deployable federated method. Test trajectories and stability audits are generated only after identification. Primary gate: oracle Family tracking at least 5% better than Local with a positive paired-seed bootstrap CI, amplitude feasibility, and frozen rho below one. Family versus LocalExtra quantifies the price of sharing heterogeneous rather than recipient-local data. No learned clustering or federated optimizer is claimed.
